text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services is recommending the installation of speed humps on Viewmount Avenue, between Glenmount Avenue and Dalemount Avenue. Staff's assessment indicates the criteria as set out in the Traffic Calming Policy has been satisfied. Therefore, speed humps should be installed on Viewmount Avenue.

North York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of speed humps on Viewmount Avenue, between Glenmount Avenue and Dalemount Avenue, generally as shown on Attachment 2, Drawing TC-697 dated May 2026, to the report (June 18, 2026) from the Director, Enforcement and Street Management, Transportation Services.
